cream, sand, stone, black, charcoal, dark olive, terracotta, muted green, and warm golden accents.

Tasteful and refined, not cheesy. Use subtle festive touches like papel picado-inspired accents, citrus, warm stone textures, celebratory drinks, and sunlit lifestyle styling.

title: Viral 2x2 Grid Ad Concept
final_prompt:
Create a high-impact viral social media advertising visual on a 1:1 square canvas. Place 4 fictional ads in a "2×2 grid" layout, each in a different category designed to stop scrolling on Instagram or TikTok.

Genres: (1) Tech / AI app, (2) Beauty / cosmetics, (3) Food & drink, (4) Fitness / wellness. All visible copy in ENGLISH. All brands fictional.

Viral design requirements:
- Eye-catching attention-stopping headlines
- Emotion-triggering hooks (surprise, urgency, FOMO, desire)
- High-contrast color palettes (neon, vivid, black + fluorescent)
- Bold layouts (overflow, diagonal placement, oversized typography)
- Thumbnail-friendly composition (centered hero, face close-up, gaze direction)
- "Salesy" social-ad cues (arrows, highlight frames, speech bubbles)

Design style:
- 2026 trending social ad aesthetic
- TikTok / Instagram ad look
- Mobile readability priority
- Photorealistic OR high-quality illustration
- Each ad includes a CTA (e.g. "Free for 24 hrs", "Limited", "3 days left")

Randomized viral elements (pick one from each list, embed in headlines):
(A) Forbidden words: "Don't miss out", "99% are doing it wrong", "Stop doing this now"
(B) Gap-reveal hooks: "Looks cute but…", "It seems normal but actually…", "This isn't what you think"
(C) Numbers / scarcity: "3 days only", "1 spot left", "Free → $0"

Important:
- 4 ads must each have clearly different vibes
- Keep the 2×2 grid structure intact
- All text legible and readable
- Intentionally include a "scroll-stopping anomaly"

Output: 1080×1080 single-image with 4 ads, all visible text in ENGLISH.
